faq.q: What is the ideal meta description length?
faq.a: Around 150–160 characters. Descriptions that are too long get truncated in search results with an ellipsis, cutting off your call to action.

faq.q: Does Google always show the full description?
faq.a: No. Google frequently rewrites or truncates descriptions based on the query. Aiming for 150–160 characters is the safest guideline.
Not directly as a ranking factor, but they strongly affect click-through rate, which indirectly benefits your SEO.

faq.q: Should I add keywords to the description?
faq.a: Include your main keyword naturally, but write for humans first. Keyword-stuffed descriptions look spammy and can be rewritten by Google.
